name: updated-flag-nullable-int64-clean-base
body: The session's dirty flag is a nullable `INT64` (`updated`, 0/1) with no `DEFAULT`, because this file's DDL uses none and the low-level parquet writer emits only STRING/INT64: a load writes the clean base (0), and a row the session's Cypher MERGE creates carries NULL (read as clean) until `mark_dirty` sets 1 — so every dirty-state reader must compare `= 1`, never a boolean. Upgrade to a true BOOLEAN column (the parquet writer gains `Col::Bool` and the DDL gains `DEFAULT 0`) if a non-null invariant or a boolean predicate is ever wanted.
